info.description:
Administration of a Lipstick server: domains, live state, request log, visitor users and API tokens, and access rules.

The API is served over TLS. The example configuration binds it to 127.0.0.1, so only the machine itself can reach it. Everything except the health check and the login endpoints needs a session: the web panel gets it from its login form, API clients from /login.

**Accounts.** Admin accounts are created on the server machine, from the console, with a password typed in the terminal: `lipstick-server admin create -username NAME`. There is no key to configure. Without an account no change is possible. Other console commands: `admin list`, `admin reset-password -username NAME`, `admin disable -username NAME`, `admin enable -username NAME`.

**Sessions.** `POST /login` with the account's username and password returns a token. Send it on each request as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The web panel uses `POST /web/login` instead, which keeps the token in an HttpOnly cookie that scripts cannot read; changes made with that cookie must carry the header `X-Lipstick-CSRF: 1`. It expires after 12 hours; `POST /logout` ends it. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.

**Example with curl.** The certificate is self-signed, so use -k:

`curl -k -X POST 'https://127.0.0.1:5052/login' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username": "jtorres", "password": "<your password>"}'`

Copy the token from the answer, then:

`curl -k -X POST 'https://127.0.0.1:5052/domains/localhost/visitor-users' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"username": "jtorres"}'`

Without a valid token the answer is 401 Unauthorized.

get.description: HTML panel that reads /stats, /requests and the daily traffic. Needs no key.
Every domain with its policies. Client keys are never returned. Needs no key.

500.description: The domains could not be read. Error: 'Unable to get domains'

post.description: Registers a domain with the key its client will use. Multiple connections are allowed unless allowMultipleConnections is false. allowedCidrs is a list of networks or addresses; empty means no restriction.

400.description: Invalid body. The message names the field, for example 'allowedCidrs must be a list of strings' or an invalid network or address

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

500.description: The domain could not be saved. Error: 'Unable to add domain'

get.description: One domain with its policies. The client key is never returned. Needs no key.

404.description: The domain does not exist. Error: 'Domain not found'

500.description: The domain could not be read. Error: 'Unable to get domain'

delete.description: Removes the domain and disconnects its clients.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain does not exist. Error: 'Domain not found'

500.description: The domain could not be deleted. Error: 'Unable to delete domain'

patch.description: Changes any of: apiKey, allowMultipleConnections, passthrough (not while the domain requires visitor auth), allowedCidrs (an empty list removes the rules), authLatched (only false: clearing the restricted mode). Clients of the domain are disconnected and reconnect with the new policy.

parameters.description: Fields to change; send only those
parameters.name: changes

400.description: Invalid body. The message names the field, for example 'allowMultipleConnections must be true or false', 'passthrough must be true or false', 'allowedCidrs must be a list of addresses or networks', or 'authLatched can only be set to false: clients set the restricted mode'

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain does not exist. Error: 'Domain not found'

409.description: Passthrough cannot be turned on for a domain that requires visitor authentication. Error: 'passthrough cannot be turned on: the domain requires visitor authentication'

500.description: The domain could not be updated. Error: 'Unable to update domain'

get.description: Bytes transferred per day between two dates, inclusive. Needs no key.

400.description: Invalid date. Error: 'Invalid 'from' parameter, use YYYY-MM-DD' or 'Invalid 'to' parameter, use YYYY-MM-DD'

500.description: The traffic could not be read. Error: 'Unable to get config', 'Unable to connect to database' or 'Unable to read traffic'

get.description: Tokens of a domain without their values: id, name, methods, path prefixes, creation time, and whether they are revoked.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain does not exist. Error: 'Domain not found'

500.description: The tokens could not be listed. Error: 'unable to list tokens'

post.description: Creates a Bearer token with permissions: methods (or "*") and path prefixes. The token value is returned once; only its SHA-256 hash is stored. The response has no id: list the tokens to get it.

400.description: Invalid body, or the token could not be created. Errors: 'token name must be 1 to 64 characters', 'a token needs at least one method, or *', or malformed JSON

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain does not exist. Error: 'Domain not found'

500.description: The domain could not be read. Error: 'Unable to get domain'

delete.description: The token stops working at once.

400.description: The id is not a number. Error: 'id must be a number'

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain or the token does not exist. Errors: 'Domain not found' or 'visitor token not found'

500.description: The domain could not be read. Error: 'Unable to get domain'

get.description: Usernames of a domain. Secrets are never returned.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain does not exist. Error: 'Domain not found'

500.description: The users could not be listed. Error: 'unable to list users'

post.description:
Creates a user of a restricted domain with its own secret. Send the secret in the body (at least 32 characters) or omit it: then the server generates one and returns it in this response, the only time it is shown. The user signs each request with HMAC-SHA256 using that secret and sends it in the Authorization header as LipstickHMAC user, ts, nonce and sig. Usernames: 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, underscores, at signs or hyphens.
Example: after logging in (see /login), curl -k -X POST 'https://127.0.0.1:5052/domains/localhost/visitor-users' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"username": "jtorres"}'. Without a valid token the answer is 401.

400.description: Invalid body, or the user could not be created. Errors: 'username must be 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, underscores, at signs or hyphens', 'secret must be at least 32 characters', 'a visitor user with that name already exists', or malformed JSON

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain does not exist. Error: 'Domain not found'

500.description: The domain could not be read. Error: 'Unable to get domain'

delete.description: Removes the user; their access ends at once.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain or the user does not exist. Errors: 'Domain not found' or 'visitor user not found'

500.description: The domain could not be read. Error: 'Unable to get domain'

post.description: Replaces the secret of a user and returns the new one, shown once. The old secret stops working at once.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session token. Error: 'Unauthorized'

404.description: The domain or the user does not exist. Errors: 'Domain not found' or 'visitor user not found'

500.description: The secret could not be rotated. Error: 'unable to rotate secret'

get.description: Reports that the admin API is up. Needs no key.

post.description: Checks an admin account and returns a session token. Send the token on every change as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". The token expires after 12 hours. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes. Accounts are created on the server machine with: lipstick-server admin create -username NAME. The web panel uses /web/login instead, which keeps the token in a cookie.

400.description: Body is not JSON with username and password

401.description: Invalid username or password. The message does not say which of the two was wrong

429.description: Too many failed logins; the Retry-After header says how long to wait

500.description: The session could not be created

post.description: Ends the session of the token or cookie of the request. The token stops working at once, and the session cookie is cleared. Changes with the cookie need the X-Lipstick-CSRF: 1 header.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session. Error: 'Unauthorized'

403.description: The X-Lipstick-CSRF header is missing on a cookie logout

500.description: The session could not be ended

get.description: Finished HTTP requests, newest first: domain, port the visitor came in on, method, path without query, status, duration and response size. Headers and bodies are never stored. Without from or to, the newest requests come from memory; with a time range they come from the database (kept 7 days). Needs no key.

parameters.description: Only this port: 5050 is the proxy, others are intranet ports
parameters.name: port

parameters.description: Start of the range: RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: End of the range: RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD (a date includes the whole day)
parameters.name: to

400.description: Invalid parameter. Error: 'port must be between 1 and 65535', 'limit must be a positive number', 'from must be RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD', 'to must be RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD', or a range error

500.description: The request log could not be read. Error: 'could not read the request log'

get.description: Clients, active sessions, pending visitors, bytes since start, and intranet ports for each domain with a hub. Needs no key.

post.description: The same check as /login, for the web panel. The token is not in the answer: it is stored in the HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie "lipstick_session", which scripts cannot read. The request must carry the header X-Lipstick-CSRF: 1.
post.summary: Log in to the web panel

400.description: Body is not JSON with username and password

429.description: Too many failed logins; the Retry-After header says how long to wait

500.description: The session could not be created

secret.description: Secret is optional. If it is omitted, the server generates one and returns it once.

port.description: proxy port or an intranet port; 0 when unknown
